verdict.rationale: Undermind's homepage shows a plan-tier comparison mentioning "10x higher usage limits" and unlimited workspaces, so a prospective buyer gets a relative sense of tiers. The $20/month price appears only in a community comment, and no first-party document states prices or concrete usage caps. Missing for 10: a first-party pricing page with plan prices, explicit numeric usage limits (searches or queries per period), free-tier limits, and enterprise pricing details.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can understand plan pricing and usage limits before committing
